! Content-blocker rules that matter to virtubooth, vendored for tests/test_core_blockers.py
! (the full lists are checked when VB_BLOCKLISTS points to a directory, see that test).
!
! Selected from the lists downloaded on 2026-10-12/13 (EasyList, EasyPrivacy, uBlock filters +
! privacy/badware/unbreak/quick fixes/annoyances/cookies/URL tracking, AdGuard Base/Tracking/
! Mobile/URL Tracking/Cookie Notices/Annoyances/German, Fanboy Annoyance/Social/Cookiemonster,
! EasyList Germany, Peter Lowe, Brave first-party/cookie lists):
!   [A] rules that blocked the app before: /static/core/fingerprint.js
!   [B] network rules whose key literal occurs in one of the app's URLs (near misses)
!   [C] generic rules that rewrite requests or responses ($removeparam, $permissions, $csp, ...)
!   [D] generic element-hiding rules that name our classes/ids/test ids, or hide
!       consent/cookie/notice/modal-like elements by attribute (plus a sample of the rest)
! Each block starts with "! list: <title>"; the rules are copied verbatim.

! list: AdGuard/uBO - URL Tracking Protection
$removeparam=/^__s=[A-Za-z0-9]{6\,}/,to=~univis.uni-erlangen.de|~univis.uni-bamberg.de|~univis.uni-luebeck.de|~univis.uni-kiel.de|~univis.th-koeln.de
$removeparam=elq,to=~app.econnect.utexas.edu|~clk.texaslonghorns.com
$to=~a8cv.amiami.jp,removeparam=a8
$to=~login.aliexpress.com|~login.aliexpress.us,removeparam=_ga
